About.subTitle: Manav Jagriti Sanstha – Vrindavan
About.introText: Manav Jagriti Sanstha is dedicated to continuous social welfare through various great and holy disciplines in Braj Bhoomi. From serving saints to protecting mute animals and conserving the environment, this organization keeps our ancient Sanatan and traditional values alive while meeting contemporary needs.

Timeline.desc: A chronicle of devotion, service, and divine grace.

1.title: Foundation of Sanstha
1.desc: The foundation of Manav Jagriti Sanstha was laid with the main objective of initiating spiritual consciousness and public welfare in society.

2.title: Sanatan Vedic Shiksha Jagriti
2.desc: A special awareness campaign was started to bring the education of basic principles of Sanatan Dharma, Vedas, and ancient Indian culture to every person.

3.title: De-Addiction Campaign
3.desc: A large-scale de-addiction movement was started from Mumbai, which liberated thousands of youths from drug addiction and brought them into the mainstream.

4.title: Female Foeticide Awareness
4.desc: A comprehensive social awareness campaign was launched from Punjab against 'Save the Girl Child' and female foeticide, which brought a major change in society.

5.title: Anti-Dowry Campaign
5.desc: A major movement was started from Rajasthan for the complete eradication of social evils like dowry and to promote simple marriages without dowry.

6.title: Anti-Child Marriage Campaign
6.desc: Social and legal awareness was spread against the marriage of minors, and many child marriages were successfully stopped.

7.title: Remarriage of Child Widows/Sisters
7.desc: A highly humanitarian campaign was started in Bihar for the remarriage and social rehabilitation of sisters suffering from the consequences of child marriage.

8.title: Sacred Water Seva
8.desc: Pure drinking water and sacred water service sites were established for the general public and travelers in pilgrimage areas and rural regions.

9.title: Anti-Cow Slaughter Campaign
9.desc: A nationwide consciousness chariot journey and peaceful movements were started for the protection, promotion of Gau Mata, and complete opposition to illegal cattle smuggling.

10.title: Helpless & Sick Cow Seva
10.desc: Ambulances, medical camps, and special cow shelters were built for the treatment of sick, terminally ill, injured, and stray cows.

11.title: Empowered India Mission
11.desc: A resolution was taken to structure a self-reliant and empowered India by connecting the youth of the country with nation-building, patriotism, and moral values.

12.title: Mass Cairva-Jatiya Marriage
12.desc: Mass inter-caste marriage events were started for daughters of economically weaker families, where weddings are solemnized with full traditional rituals.

13.title: Anti-Corruption & Employment Drive
13.desc: A voice was raised against corruption, and work was started to provide employment opportunities to youth through skill development.

GauSevaImportance.heading: The Spiritual and Sanatan Significance of Gau Seva
GauSevaImportance.p: The scriptures state that in this Kali Yuga, there is no sacrifice (Yajna) as accessible and rewarding as the service of the cow. Offering a morsel of food to Gau Mata naturally alleviates ancestral afflictions (Pitru Dosh), planetary obstacles (Navagraha Dosha), and all forms of mental distress. Residing in the sacred dust of Vrindavan, serving the helpless and destitute cows is the fundamental source of pleasing Thakur Shri Banke Bihari Ji.

philosophy.meaning: Cows are the mothers of the entire universe; the welfare of nature and humanity lies in their protection.
It is believed that all 330 million deities reside within the sacred form of the Divine Cow (Gau Mata).

KathaAmountInfo.heading: Essential Rules & Guidelines:
KathaAmountInfo.p1: Vyaspith Protocols: Only Vedic Sanatan principles and narrations from authentic scriptures will be recited from the institute's Vyaspith (main podium).
KathaAmountInfo.p2: Ashram Accommodation Policy: If the event is held at the Vrindavan Ashram, accommodation and satvik (pure) meals for the host's guests (up to 30 people) will be managed by the Ashram.
KathaAmountInfo.p3: External Events: For events organized at private residences or public pandals, the host party must ensure convenient travel and satvik accommodation for the Vyas Ji (main narrator) and the musical team.
KathaAmountInfo.p4: If you have any questions regarding date extensions, selection of the Vyas Peeth Acharya, or tax exemption (80G benefits) on donations, please feel free to contact us.

BrajDarshanMilestone.heading: Sacred Braj Pilgrimage Sites
BrajDarshanMilestone.p: Holy Stops on the Divine Journey

YatraMotive.p: Our supreme resolve is to preserve the eternal and priceless heritage of Braj Mandal, where the divine Nikunj pastimes of Lord Shri Krishna continue to manifest even today.

1.title: Revival of Values & Cultural Heritage
1.desc: To revive the timeless Sanatan values that are gradually fading in the modern world and reconnect the younger generation with their original cultural and Vedic roots.

2.title: Environmental & Spiritual Preservation
2.desc: To inspire devotion and reverence toward Braj's ancient forests, sacred ponds, and holy hills, ensuring the conservation and protection of this divine ecological heritage.

3.title: Bhakti Yoga & Inner Purification
3.desc: The primary purpose of this sacred 252-kilometer pilgrimage is not tourism, but the purification of the heart through Naam Sankirtan (devotional chanting) in the holy company of saints.

YatraFacilities.heading: Facilities Available for Devotees
YatraFacilities.p: Ensuring a Safe and Spiritually Enriching Pilgrimage Experience

1.title: Convenient Transportation (Transport Control)
1.desc: Luggage transport services for pilgrims walking on foot, along with comfortable air-conditioned (AC) buses and vehicles specially arranged for elderly devotees.

2.title: Sattvic Meals
2.desc: Pure sattvic Braj Prasadam prepared with desi ghee under the guidance of saints, along with medicinal drinking water and timely refreshments throughout the pilgrimage.

3.title: Sacred Accommodation (Vedic Camps)
3.desc: Safe, clean, and spiritually uplifting ashrams and modern camps equipped with comfortable amenities for overnight stays during the pilgrimage.

4.title: Medical Care & Safety
4.desc: A dedicated first-aid team, ambulance backup, and security personnel accompany the pilgrimage to ensure prompt medical assistance and the safety of all devotees.

TempleAboutConcept.p1: Our ancient temples are not merely structures made of bricks and stones or ordinary places of worship; they are living centers of our magnificent art, history, advanced astronomical knowledge, and social consciousness.
TempleAboutConcept.p2: When a sacred place is destroyed or neglected due to the harsh impacts of time, natural disasters, or narrow-minded ideologies, it is not just a building that is lost, but an invaluable chapter of our rich civilization and spiritual heritage is lost forever.
TempleAboutConcept.subheading2: Reconstruction without altering the original architectural design.
TempleAboutConcept.subheading4: Reconnecting the local community with daily prayers, rituals, and festivals.
TempleAboutConcept.footer: There can be no greater human and spiritual endeavor than bringing back the sacred chants, temple bells, and Vedic mantras once again into the broken and silent places of worship.

CoreMotos.p: The reconstruction of temples is not merely the collection of stones, but the restoration of the cultural consciousness of society.

Methodology.p: The restoration of sacred sites is carried out in four major phases by combining the principles of scriptures with the precision of modern technology.
